title: VibeGraph quality layer: skill manifest
description: The structured view of one thread skill: its rules, each with its why and the IR nodes it governs (M-WHY), optionally bound to a stated constraint's check so the two can be compared; the stamp the skill was ratified against; and the staling rules that decide when it stops injecting. Derived from the skill file and the constraint store by a script; a human ratifies by editing the skill file's status, exactly as thread_skill_store.ts does today. C.8 settled that constraints beat skills: a rule that contradicts a routed constraint carries the contradiction record and the skill reads stale.

status.description: Mirrors SkillStatus in thread_skill_store.ts. Anything not exactly ratified is draft.

stale.description: Derived at read time from the stamp; never persisted as authority.

sourceHash.description: The thread IR hash the skill was stamped with (sourceHashOf).

rulesHash.description: The hash of the constraints routed to the thread when stamped (M-WHY). Unknown on a skill stamped before M-WHY, with that reason.

snapshotPresent.description: Whether a step snapshot exists, so the stale card can show a diff (M-SKILL.7).

omitted.description: Run 3: bullets of the `## Rules and why` section the deriver could NOT turn into a Rule, each with its line and the reason (no why stated; no IR node cited). Honest absence, never a defaulted rule.

why.description: Never empty: a rule without its reason gets worked around by the next agent that meets a case it did not foresee.

nodes.description: The IR nodes the rule governs. Never empty.

source.description: constraint: drafted from a routed constraint's why. worker-draft: the worker's own observation, unratified until a human says so. human: written by a human in the skill file.

boundTo.description: Optional binding to a stated constraint's check, so the manifest can say whether the rule and the check agree.

contradiction.description: Recorded when a routed constraint forbids what this rule permits (RUN1 5.1 step 6). The constraint wins; the skill is staled.

on.description: step-changed and rule-changed: M-SKILL.7 and M-WHY, one stamp. constraint-contradiction: RUN1 5.1 step 6. bound-check-retired: the check a rule was bound to left the quality model. bound-constraint-removed: the constraint a rule was bound to was removed.

reaffirm.description: human: Re-affirm re-stamps without regeneration. auto-with-caveat: the per-skill opt-in keeps injecting with a stated caveat (M-SKILL.7).
